summary: Students enrolled in Summer Session 2026 courses are asked to complete the course evaluation between 4 August and 11 August 2026. Evaluations are submitted through the My SNU portal or the Seoul National University mobile app. Students who have not completed the evaluation cannot view their grades until the evaluation period ends.
applies_to: Students enrolled in undergraduate and graduate courses in the 2026 Summer Session. 'Graduate Thesis Research' (대학원 논문연구) courses are not evaluated. The notice asks for participation but does not state that it is mandatory. However, students cannot view their grades during the evaluation period unless they have completed the evaluation.

dates.what: Course evaluation period for all Summer Session 2026 students
After this point, all students can view grades, whether or not they completed the evaluation
dates.when: After the evaluation period ends (after 11 August 2026)

conditions: Graduate Thesis Research (대학원 논문연구) courses are excluded from the evaluation.
During the evaluation period, students can view their grades only after completing the course evaluation.
After the evaluation period ends, grades can be viewed regardless of whether the student completed the evaluation.
Only the average scores of some common items are used in evaluations such as those for strengthening faculty teaching capacity.
Scores in the specialised area (collaborative team-teaching courses) are used in reviews for selecting collaborative team-teaching courses.
The college-specific optional questions used up to Spring 2025 have been removed because the course evaluation has been revised.
steps: Read Attachment 1, 'Course Evaluation Program Guide (for Students)' (강의평가 프로그램 안내(학생용).hwp). Its content was not read for this translation.
Log in to the My SNU portal (포털 마이스누) or the Seoul National University mobile app (서울대학교 모바일 앱).
Go to Academic Administration (학사행정) ⇒ Classes/Grades (수업/성적) ⇒ Grades (성적) ⇒ Course Evaluation (강의평가).
Complete the evaluation for each of your Summer Session 2026 courses by Tuesday 11 August 2026.
translation:
Course Evaluation for the 2026 Summer Session

The course evaluation for the 2026 Summer Session will be conducted as follows. All enrolled students are encouraged to participate.

1. Period: Tuesday 4 August 2026 to Tuesday 11 August 2026 (2026. 8. 4.(화) ~ 8. 11.(화))

2. Method: the My SNU portal (포털 마이스누) or the Seoul National University mobile app (서울대학교 모바일 앱)
   - My SNU portal / Seoul National University mobile app ⇒ Academic Administration (학사행정) ⇒ Classes/Grades (수업/성적) ⇒ Grades (성적) ⇒ Course Evaluation (강의평가)

3. Courses evaluated: all undergraduate and graduate courses, except 'Graduate Thesis Research' (대학원 논문연구)

4. Main points of the course evaluation
※ Only the average scores of some common items are used in evaluations such as those for strengthening faculty teaching capacity.
   (However, scores in the specialised area (collaborative team-teaching courses) are used in reviews for selecting collaborative team-teaching courses.)
※ The procedure for entering college-specific optional questions, used up to Spring 2025, has been removed because the course evaluation has been revised.

5. Important: During the evaluation period, you can view your grades only after completing the course evaluation. After the evaluation period ends, grades can be viewed regardless of whether you completed the evaluation.

Attachment 1. Guide to the Course Evaluation Method (for Students), 1 copy.
Attachment 2. Course Evaluation Questionnaire

Attached files (2):
[Attachment 1] Course Evaluation Program Guide (for Students) (강의평가 프로그램 안내(학생용).hwp) (3 MB)
[Attachment 2] Course Evaluation Questionnaire (강의평가 문항지.hwpx) (55 KB)

(Note: The contents of the attachments were not read for this translation.)
